title: Resolve Ledger
description: STRUCTURAL AUTHORITY for /review resolve ledgers (D-LSC-Q1a, D-LSC-Q1b, ledger-schema-conformance research R1-R4). This artifact -- not C67 prose, not protocol.md, not SKILL.md -- is the field contract. Every derived tool (the skeleton generator, the round-N+1 compile, the close gates) MUST read its field set FROM HERE. A hand-maintained key list anywhere else recreates the split authority this cycle exists to remove (D-LSC-Q2b-sub-vii, binding).

corpus_measurement_at_authoring.note: Only 3 of 212 observed keys appear in every ledger. `additionalProperties` is therefore TRUE by deliberate design: ledgers legitimately carry topic-specific keys, and a closed-world object would reject essentially the entire corpus. This schema constrains the CONTRACT fields; it does not forbid extension.

known_nonconformant_at_authoring.note: 25 of 163 tracked ledgers fail strict `schema_version` validation TODAY. Retroactive application is an explicit operator decision recorded in the runbook, NOT assumed here. The round-N+1 compile validates the round just written (forward-only).

agentic_panel_accounting.rule: Optional historical compatibility: absent agentic_panel adds no admission checks. Present seats have unique nonblank seat IDs and per-seat attempt IDs; at most one current attempt, selected when present. Retained native/final file identities must be distinct across roles, including within one attempt, and across seat/attempt owners; equal bytes in distinct files remain valid. A selected superseded attempt never revives. Admitted equals protocol responding, requires a selected current attempt with native session and final evidence and a raw verdict. A non-null raw verdict requires retained selected final evidence even for a rejected response. Agentic seat IDs are dispatched; their responding projection equals panel.responded intersect agentic seat IDs, allowing mixed web panels. Nonresponding seats receive no PASS-floor credit. FAIL never receives credit; record_only admitted PASS/monitoring retains credit. Qualified removal requires bound selected admission evidence. Independently bound absent or incomplete requested accounts remove only floor credit; evidence consumers verify account content and any material contradiction. Qualified activation cannot precede first_round and requires non-null authorization and qualification references. Every cause remains nonblank. Unproved effective identity requires explicit unknowns; a claimed effective profile/family requires an evidence reference, whose truth and applicability remain consumer duties.
agentic_panel_accounting.locked_by: D-APRI-Q3-S1, D-APRI-Q3-S2, D-APRI-R2-O2-L, D-APRI-R2-O8-R, D-APRI-R2-O8-G, D-APRI-R3-F2-P, Locked R4 F2.QL

agentic_unadmitted_provenance.rule: Unadmitted evidence requires agentic_panel and a known seat/attempt with a retained matching final_ref. It cannot refer to the admitted current attempt. Duplicate seat/attempt provenance is rejected. Existing finding.sources subset of panel.responded remains unconditional; unadmitted provenance supplies evidence, never a vote. A finding may also retain sources from admitted responders. A classified finding requires non-null reproduction_ref on every unadmitted provenance row, validated against independent resolve authority by the evidence consumer. An unclassified null requires reproduction_status not-reproducible or not-yet-reproduced plus a nonblank reproduction_reason; it cannot authorize classification or voting credit.

x-cross-field-invariants.description: Constraints JSON Schema cannot express. The validator MUST enforce these at the application layer; they are recorded here so this artifact remains the single field authority.

sources_subset_of_panel_responded.rule: For every finding with attribution_state == 'attributed', every member of findings[].sources MUST appear in panel.responded.
sources_subset_of_panel_responded.rationale: This cross-check is what converted the R1 DISMISS bloc -- it makes impossible attribution mechanically rejectable. D-LSC-Q3b-sub-token (9/9) left it COMPLETELY untouched: no amendment, no sentinel carve-out, no namespace reservation.

skeleton_key_set_identity.rule: The compiler-emitted skeleton's key set MUST equal the CYCLE-EFFECTIVE required set: this schema's root `required`, PLUS the requirements of whichever conditional branch applies to the ledger's cycle_type, PLUS one complete alternative of each applicable anyOf. The generator MUST assert this against an independently-derived set and fail the compile on drift. (Earlier wording said 'equal this schema's required set' -- which the implementation never did and could not: a root-only skeleton omits decisions_locked, the finding tallies, and every timestamp alternative, so it can never satisfy the contract it scaffolds.)

coverage_arithmetic.not_applicable: excluded from BOTH; reported as a separate count
coverage_arithmetic.zero_eligible: report n/a -- NEVER 100%. 'Nothing was attributable' is not 'all attribution succeeded'.
coverage_arithmetic.presentation: attributed / eligible (N not-applicable) -- never a bare percentage

cited_constraint_ids_must_be_live.rule: C80: the id MUST exist in constraints.md. A load-bearing citation MUST additionally be non-deprecated. A DEPRECATED id may appear ONLY with weight: decorative AND a non-empty `note` contextualizing the supersession (protocol.md, Primitive 3 / C80). One rule, one wording -- three formulations across three surfaces was split authority reintroduced inside the artifact meant to end it.
cited_constraint_ids_must_be_live.rationale: Three tombstoned constraints were cited as live in a single session, every instance surfaced by a command rather than a reader. Same shape as the sources-subset check.

panel_set_algebra.rule: responded MUST be a subset of dispatched; non_response MUST equal dispatched minus responded; all three arrays MUST be duplicate-free; distinct_sources MUST equal len(set(responded)).
panel_set_algebra.rationale: Only sources-subset-of-responded was enforced, so a ledger could attribute a finding to a model that was never dispatched, and distinct_sources could be any integer. C71 defines respondents and non-responses FROM the dispatched set.

skeleton_sentinel_is_a_reserved_token.rule: The literal string "__UNSET__" is RESERVED across the ENTIRE instance, including the topic-specific extension keys that additionalProperties:true otherwise permits. No field may carry it as legitimate data.
skeleton_sentinel_is_a_reserved_token.rationale: The in-schema check fires only where the evaluator recurses, which requires a `properties` entry; with additionalProperties true, an extension key carrying a surviving scaffold value was never visited at all. Reserving the token globally is what makes "a scaffold value is never valid, whatever the type allows" actually unconditional. The cost is explicit: the token cannot be legitimate data anywhere in a ledger.

reconstructors_predeclared_per_check.rule: Reconstruction procedures are PREDECLARED per check. When `check_results` is present, EVERY `check_results[].check` MUST have a matching `reconstructors[].check` entry -- including checks that PASS. `reconstructors: []` is the affirmative 'no approved procedure' claim that legitimizes UNVERIFIABLE / NO_APPROVED_RECONSTRUCTOR; an outcome for a check with NO declaration at all is MALFORMED, not unverifiable. reason_code and the declared list must agree: NO_APPROVED_RECONSTRUCTOR requires an EMPTY list, and RECONSTRUCTION_INCOMPLETE / RECONSTRUCTION_AMBIGUOUS require a NON-empty one. Each exact, case-sensitive check name MUST have at most one check_results entry; duplicate names are MALFORMED even when outcomes agree.
reconstructors_predeclared_per_check.locked_by: D-LSC-Q4b-trigger binding caveat (operator force-disposition); duplicate check-name identity: operator-authorized unversioned maintenance SW-D14 (2026-10-14)
reconstructors_predeclared_per_check.rationale: The caveat is a MUST and the shipped shape could not express it: both fields were optional and structurally unrelated, so an UNVERIFIABLE with NO declaration validated clean, and a declaration for a DIFFERENT check validated clean beside it. JSON Schema cannot state a cross-array quantified rule, so this joins the other two application-layer invariants.
reconstructors_predeclared_per_check.explicitly_not_enforced: TEMPORAL predeclaration -- 'the procedure existed BEFORE the outcome was recorded' -- is unprovable from a single artifact, because resolve writes the declaration and the outcome atomically. It stays a writer-side obligation. Recording the limit here is the point: an unenforceable clause left implicit reads as coverage it does not have.
reconstructors_predeclared_per_check.producer_status: ARMED BUT UNWIRED: no protocol step writes `check_results` today, so the third gate outcome has no producer. The binding is enforced whenever the field appears; wiring a producer is a separate decision.

supersession_is_a_disposition_not_a_defe.rule: A citation whose id is DEPRECATED in the current corpus is classified SUPERSESSION, not violation -- for BOTH deprecated branches (load-bearing, and decorative-without-note) symmetrically. An id absent from the corpus entirely is NEVER supersession: unrecognized is not retired, and it always blocks.
supersession_is_a_disposition_not_a_defe.why_schema_cannot_express_it: The class is a function of corpus state AT READ TIME, not of the document. The same bytes are clean or superseded depending on when constraints.md is consulted, so no schema keyword can decide it and the application layer MUST.

enforcement_by_caller.write_time: BLOCKING (default). The ledger is not sealed yet, so the citation is repairable and blocking is an instruction the writer can act on.
enforcement_by_caller.round_n_plus_1_bundle: SURFACED, never halting. Round N is sealed; C67 makes it read-only and D-LSC-Q4a (9/9) found no sound era discriminator, so there is no legal repair. Halting here blocked round N+1 permanently and was live on 12 topics at once. Since R3 it also emits to stderr -- 'does not halt' had been implemented as 'is silent'.
enforcement_by_caller.close_step_0d: ADJUDICATED. The only gate that reads a sealed artifact with the operator present; it passes --accept-supersession and records the disposition. Without that flag the same status exits 1.

supersession_is_a_disposition_not_a_defe.discriminator: REPAIRABILITY, not caller convenience: block where the operator can act, surface where they cannot, adjudicate where they are standing there.
supersession_is_a_disposition_not_a_defe.default_direction: STRICT. --accept-supersession relaxes and is off unless passed. A default that relaxed would apply to every caller who never heard of the class -- the C81 opt-in-misconfiguration shape pointed backwards. Shipped inverted at R2 and corrected at R3 after the panel reproduced it.
supersession_is_a_disposition_not_a_defe.explicitly_not_enforced: TEMPORAL. Whether the id was live WHEN THE LEDGER WAS WRITTEN is not checked and cannot be: no era discriminator exists (D-LSC-Q4a, 9/9). A citation retired before the ledger was written is indistinguishable here from one retired after.
supersession_is_a_disposition_not_a_defe.open_question_carried_to_r4: A SEALED artifact carrying an unrepairable MALFORMATION (as opposed to a supersession) currently halts the round-N+1 bundle, which the same repairability argument says it should not. One instance exists in the live corpus (manifest-sidecar-atomicity implementation r1, duplicate 'round' member, both values 1 so nothing was lost). Not settled at R3.
supersession_is_a_disposition_not_a_defe.locked_by: D-LSC-Q4a (9/9) + R3 panel unanimous overturn of the R2 default

indeterminacy_implies_unverifiable.rule: Each of the five INDETERMINACY reason_codes (MISSING_PRIMARY_EVIDENCE, EVIDENCE_INACCESSIBLE, NO_APPROVED_RECONSTRUCTOR, RECONSTRUCTION_INCOMPLETE, RECONSTRUCTION_AMBIGUOUS) REQUIRES outcome: UNVERIFIABLE. CHECK_NOT_APPLICABLE requires NOT_APPLICABLE and is its own pair. Every reason_code is therefore bound to exactly one outcome in both directions.
indeterminacy_implies_unverifiable.rationale: The forward direction was enforced and the converse was not, so an indeterminate check could be recorded as PASS with its own indeterminacy code sitting beside it and the rollup agreed. Enforced in-schema, not at the application layer: unlike the corpus-state invariants this one is a pure function of the document.

schema_version.description: JSON STRING '1.0', NOT integer 1. The integer form violates the writer contract stated verbatim in protocol.md and SKILL.md; 21 tracked ledgers carry it. Recorded as a live defect, not accommodated.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 with timezone. Writer-declared and therefore NOT a sound era discriminator (D-LSC-Q4a, 9/9): earlier rounds carried hand-typed placeholders.

predicates.description: Branch predicate evaluation. Booleans only -- the branch is deterministic.

hard_cap_override_state.description: THE FIELD THIS CYCLE EXISTS TO EXPLAIN. Omitted in 6 of 6 rounds where the cap was in force during audit-scope-seal. R4 established C67 was never obliged to name it -- C67's six-key list is a scoped 'v3.24 R2 schema extensions' delta and this field predates it by 12 days. 'not_applicable' is a TOTAL-ENUM member (D-LSC-Q3b-sub P1 domain completeness): omission must never be the encoding for a real state.

responded.description: May be empty when a nonempty dispatched panel has no admitted response. The dispatched set remains nonempty.

non_response.description: C71: models dispatched but absent. Required on v3.20+ implementation rounds.

panel.description: C71. `dispatched` absent from all 18 audit-scope-seal ledgers -- one of the two shapes that broke the v3.45 close gates. Dispatched identities are nonempty: `[""]` satisfied `type: string` and let a finding be attributed to a nameless model. A dispatched panel may validly have zero admitted responders.

panel_set_notes.description: ARRAY, not a string. Written as a bare string in 16 of 18 audit-scope-seal ledgers -- the second shape that broke the v3.45 close gates. C71 waiver one-liners live here.

cited_constraints.description: C80. Empty array is a POSITIVE claim of 'no constraints cited'. Field omission or JSON null halts close 0.d as malformed-ledger -- null is NOT a positive claim.

id.description: C80: the id MUST exist in constraints.md. A load-bearing citation MUST additionally be non-deprecated. A DEPRECATED id may appear ONLY with weight: decorative AND a non-empty `note` contextualizing the supersession (protocol.md, Primitive 3 / C80). One rule, one wording -- three formulations across three surfaces was split authority reintroduced inside the artifact meant to end it.

planned_constraint_appends.description: C67 v3.24 R2 extension. Empty array is a positive claim of 'no appends planned'.

retire_when.description: Full grammar per branch. The prior pattern value-validated ONLY the `disuse:` alternative, so `until:banana` and a bare `event:` passed -- delegating the field list must not silently relax a VALUE constraint. Anchored with `$`, not `\Z`: under this artifact's declared dialect (Draft 2020-12 -> ECMA-262) `\Z` is an identity escape for a literal 'Z', so a conformant engine would reject every valid value. The validator normalizes `$` to end-of-input; the artifact stays dialect-clean.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 with timezone. Historical ledger-schema-conformance research recorded `timestamp` and `created_at` usage (99/163 vs 64/163) and divergent prose names. Current protocol.md and SKILL.md writer contracts delegate the field contract to this schema, which requires AT LEAST ONE of the two names. The separately recorded naming reconciliation remains OPEN; prose delegation does not select a single name.

sequence_evidence.description: D-ICSA-Q1a/Q2b. Present only for ordered-step records; its presence is the sequence-aware carrier, not a mutable progress pointer.

agentic_panel.description: Optional recorded agentic contract. Shape and pure accounting do not establish dispatch authority, evidence integrity or production qualification.

investigate_count.description: protocol.md's research writer-contract name. The corpus also uses `investigate`. Accepted as EITHER; reconciling the two prose surfaces onto one name is an OPEN item.

check_results.description: Per-check gate outcomes (D-LSC-Q4b). Optional, but when present every entry is validated against $defs/check_result -- an orphan $def is an unenforced spec.

reconstructors.description: PREDECLARED per-check reconstruction procedures (binding caveat on the (B) evidence-availability trigger). The validator must never improvise historical inference.

resolve_authority_ref.description: Optional resolve-time lead authority, independently bound by operation dispatch evidence; retained reproduction supplies no seat vote.

content_b64.description: Exact historical bytes in canonical base64. New sequence producers and historical consumers require this carrier and enforce strict decoding, a 262144-byte decoded bound, and the sha256 match. Optional here solely for structural compatibility with earlier records; absence cannot prove historical retrievability.

sources.description: HOMOGENEOUS collection of panelist identities. NEVER a sentinel, NEVER a mixed domain (D-LSC-Q3b-sub-token, 9/9). Cross-field: when attributed, MUST be a subset of panel.responded -- enforced at the application layer.

attribution_state.description: Adjacent epistemic state. `system_derived` is PROVENANCE and MUST NOT enter this enum (9/9): a finding surfaced by a command has a determinate origin -- it is attributed TO TOOLING. Calling it unattributed erases the most interesting signal in the corpus. Provenance gets its own field if needed.

attribution_reason.description: Required when NOT attributed. The affirmative-negative lock (D-LSC-Q3b-sub-encoding) demands the negative carry information, not just a label.

check_result.description: D-LSC-Q4b + operator force-disposition. Per-check, NEVER per-ledger -- the ledger level is a rollup, never a primitive.

outcome.description: Named UNVERIFIABLE, NOT LEGACY_UNVERIFIABLE (9/9): the state is epistemic, not temporal, and the prefix would bake in a cause D-LSC-Q4a already dismissed. Precedence FAIL > UNVERIFIABLE > PASS is NORMATIVE -- an unreconstructable field must never mask a real failure. NOT_APPLICABLE (determinate-inapplicable) and UNVERIFIABLE (indeterminate) are DISTINCT states.

reason_code.description: Machine-readable classifier. Free text may accompany it but must not replace it -- the per-reason_code breakdown is what lets the close record expose accumulation.

override.description: Layers OVER the outcome. MUST NOT rewrite `outcome` to PASS (D-LSC-Q4b, 9/9).

allOf.title: override-must-not-rewrite-to-PASS
allOf.description: D-LSC-Q4b (9/9): an operator override LAYERS OVER the outcome; it must never rewrite it to PASS. Without this the exact forbidden state validated clean and rolled up PASS.

allOf.title: CHECK_NOT_APPLICABLE-belongs-to-NOT_APPLICABLE
allOf.description: NOT_APPLICABLE (determinate-inapplicable) and UNVERIFIABLE (indeterminate) are DISTINCT states; sharing the reason_code collapses them.

allOf.title: NOT_APPLICABLE-takes-only-CHECK_NOT_APPLICABLE
allOf.description: The converse of the branch above, and the half that was missing: `CHECK_NOT_APPLICABLE` implied `NOT_APPLICABLE`, but `NOT_APPLICABLE` accepted ANY reason_code -- so `{outcome: NOT_APPLICABLE, reason_code: MISSING_PRIMARY_EVIDENCE}` validated clean. That pairs determinate-inapplicable with the signature of indeterminacy, and the rollup then excludes it as determinate: an unverifiable check laundered into the clean bucket, which is exactly the erode-toward-PASS failure the anti-default lock names.

allOf.title: indeterminacy-reason_codes-belong-to-UNVERIFIABLE
allOf.description: The converse of the UNVERIFIABLE-requires-a-reason_code branch, and the half that was missing: UNVERIFIABLE implied a reason_code, but every INDETERMINACY reason_code accepted ANY outcome -- so {outcome: PASS, reason_code: NO_APPROVED_RECONSTRUCTOR} validated clean and rolled up PASS. That is the affirmative 'no approved procedure' state laundered into the clean bucket, which is exactly the erode-toward-PASS failure the anti-default lock names, and exactly the shape already fixed one branch over for NOT_APPLICABLE.

reconstructor_declaration.description: BINDING CAVEAT on the (B) evidence-availability trigger (operator force-disposition). Reconstruction procedures MUST be PREDECLARED per check -- either an empty array or a named deterministic set. The validator MUST NOT improvise historical inference: unbounded 'reliable reconstruction' turns the trigger into hidden policy code and recreates D-LSC-Q4a's dismissed era-keying one field at a time.

reconstructors.description: Empty array = no approved reconstructor; absence of evidence then legitimately yields UNVERIFIABLE.

allOf.title: timestamp-or-created_at
allOf.description: At least one ISO-8601 timestamp field must be present.

allOf.title: implementation-cycle writer contract (protocol.md, C71)
allOf.description: Implementation ledgers carry finding tallies and a non_response panel arm. Omitting these is exactly the class of gate-invalid-but-schema-valid ledger that forced the v3.45 overrides.

findings.description: protocol.md's implementation contract requires each finding to carry id, classification and disposition.

allOf.title: research-cycle writer contract (protocol.md)
allOf.description: Research ledgers carry the decision tallies the close reads.

cap.description: protocol.md's research writer-contract fixes the research cap at 4. Delegating the field list must not silently relax a VALUE constraint -- that is the same defect relocated.

allOf.title: ordered-step completion contract (D-ICSA-Q1a)
allOf.description: advance is a nonterminal completion with handoff pending. It cannot stand in for successor execution or terminal close.

allOf.title: sequenced roll and halt identity contract (D-ICSA-Q1a)
allOf.description: When sequence_evidence is present, roll and halt retain step and entry identity; legacy records remain structurally valid without it.
